I've visited this restaurant before, and previous experiences were better, particularly during Ramadan when they offer an attractive and diverse buffet. The Ramadan buffet starts at 8:30, but it's best to arrive early due to high customer demand.

The maduros, or sweet plantains, are a must-try with their caramelized exterior and soft interior. Refreshing drinks like Inca cola and chicha limena complete the experience. This chicken is made with love and will redefine your perception of rotisserie chicken.
Revise this with your best effort:
Experience the ultimate delight at Cuenelli's Peruvian Style Rotisserie Chicken, where every bite of our mouthwatering chicken is a testament to perfection. Our secret marinade and impeccable seasoning create a symphony of flavors that will mesmerize your taste buds. Uniquely, cooked over charcoal, our chicken bears a smoky essence that sets it apart.

Indulge in the tantalizing combination of our impeccable chicken with an array of exquisite dipping sauces, elevating your culinary journey to new heights. Our sides, including aromatic cilantro rice and a fiery, yet savory, serving of spicy pinto beans, harmonize flawlessly, creating a meal that leaves a lasting impression.

Succumb to the allure of our maduros, sweet plantains, which unveil a captivating caramelized exterior while maintaining their heavenly softness within. Each bite is a divine indulgence that transports your senses to a realm of pure pleasure.

To complete this extraordinary experience, tantalize your palate with refreshing beverages that accompany our cuisine impeccably. Sip on Inca cola, an iconic Peruvian drink, or relish the distinctive flavors of chicha limena, a traditional favorite. These refreshing elixirs are the perfect companions to our delectable rotisserie chicken.

At Cuenelli's, our dedication and love for our craft shines through every aspect of our cuisine, transforming the ordinary into something truly extraordinary. Let our exceptional rotisserie chicken redefine your perception, leaving you yearning for more with each mouthwatering bite.

input: Went to this Philadelphia pub before a show in the University City area. Convenient location near the train station and Drexel University with street parking available nearby. Service was satisfactory for dinner. Mac and cheese appetizer had a nice crunchy topping, but taste was average. Cheesesteak egg rolls were decent, although lacking in meat. Accompanied by ketchup and a flavorful mustard with horseradish. The chicken pot pie had ample vegetables and all white meat, but not a lot of chicken. Crust was mostly flaky, but one section seemed undercooked. Desserts were generous in size. Bread pudding was average and served with vanilla ice cream. Brownie was dry and lacked flavor, but may be subjective to personal taste.
Revise this with your best effort:
I visited a Philadelphia pub in the University City area before a show. The pub is conveniently located near the train station and Drexel University, and there is street parking available nearby. The service for dinner was satisfactory. 

For appetizers, the mac and cheese had a nice crunchy topping, but the taste was just average. The cheesesteak egg rolls were decent, although they could have had more meat. They were served with ketchup and a flavorful mustard with horseradish. 

Moving on to the main course, the chicken pot pie had a good amount of vegetables and all white meat, but it had a shortage of chicken. The crust was mostly flaky, although there was one section that seemed undercooked. 

The desserts were quite generous in size. The bread pudding was average and came with a serving of vanilla ice cream. However, the brownie was dry and lacked flavor. It's important to note that this opinion may vary depending on personal taste preferences.

input: I attended a bachelorette party here on a Saturday night in April. Arrive early to avoid the long line. The cover band is amazing, and there were many other celebratory groups. Signature cocktails are good but expensive. Ideal for bachelorette parties or birthdays, but crowded on regular nights.
Revise this with your best effort: I had the pleasure of attending a bustling bachelorette party at this venue on a lively Saturday night in April. To ensure a seamless experience, it's advisable to arrive early and dodge the lengthy queues. The cover band, needless to say, delivered an outstanding performance that left us utterly mesmerized. Furthermore, the atmosphere was pulsating with numerous other jubilant groups, creating an infectious celebratory vibe. While the signature cocktails undoubtedly exuded quality, it's worth noting that they leaned towards the pricier side. This spot is an ideal choice for bachelorette parties or birthdays, as it effortlessly embraces the cheerful festivities. However, it is important to brace oneself for bustling crowds on regular nights.

input: The best fall off the bone BBQ I've ever had! Pulled pork had a perfect smoky flavor, and the mac and cheese was creamy and delicious. Fast and friendly service. The walnut brownie and ice cream dessert was delightful. A great find!
Revise this with your best effort: I've had some amazing BBQ in the past, but this place delivered the best fall off the bone experience I've ever had! The pulled pork had a flawlessly smoky flavor that left me craving more, and the mac and cheese was not only creamy but also incredibly delicious. The service was lightning fast and friendly, adding to the overall fantastic experience. Let's not forget the walnut brownie and ice cream dessert, which was an absolute delight! I consider this place a hidden gem that I'm thrilled to have discovered.

input: I had a disappointing experience at Copabanana during restaurant week. The outdoor seating was disturbed by noisy kids playing football, even after we moved. The food was subpar, with overcooked steak and stale mashed potatoes. The only positive was the friendly waitress, but even she couldn't salvage the experience. I won't be returning. 1 star for the waitress.
Revise this with your best effort: My experience at Copabanana during restaurant week was quite disappointing. Despite initially choosing outdoor seating to enjoy a peaceful meal, our tranquility was continuously disturbed by noisy kids playing football nearby, even after we relocated to another table. Furthermore, the food itself left much to be desired. The steak was overcooked and the mashed potatoes tasted stale. Thankfully, the positive aspect of our visit was the friendly waitress who provided attentive service. However, even her efforts couldn't salvage the overall experience. Based on this encounter, I have no intentions of returning to Copabanana in the future. I reluctantly award one star solely for the commendable service of the waitress.

input: The shrimp and grits at this place are unbeatable, and the fresh juices complement the meal perfectly. Even after two visits in two years, my fiance still believes it's the best he's ever had.
Revise this with your best effort: The shrimp and grits offered at this establishment are simply unparalleled, and the accompanying fresh juices serve as the ideal complement to the already exceptional meal. Despite having dined here on two separate occasions over the span of two years, my fiancé remains unwavering in his opinion that it is unequivocally the finest rendition he has ever tasted.

input: Finally! A gem in Nashville for tapas! The staff is friendly and the open kitchen adds to the ambiance. The food is absolutely delicious. Can't wait to return and explore more of their menu.
Revise this with your best effort: At last! Nashville boasts a delightful gem for tapas enthusiasts! The establishment not only showcases a friendly and accommodating staff, but their open kitchen concept heightens the overall dining experience. Indulging in their delectable dishes was an absolute pleasure, leaving me eagerly anticipating my next visit to further delve into their enticing menu offerings.

input: Awesome seafood, no fuss, and the sourdough bread was delicious! The cherry on top was the fantastic 80s music playing in the background.
Revise this with your best effort: The seafood was simply amazing, effortlessly served with no complications, and the sourdough bread was a sheer delight to the taste buds! And to add the perfect touch, the background filled with nostalgic 80s music was like the cherry on top of an already wonderful experience.

input: Dr. Curtis Dechant provides exceptional care with a friendly attitude, creating a positive patient-doctor relationship. The office is comfortable and equipped with the latest technology, making eye appointments more pleasant. The eyeglass frame selection and accommodating staff are also noteworthy.
Revise this with your best effort: Dr. Curtis Dechant stands out for his remarkable patient care and warm demeanor, fostering a truly positive rapport with his patients. Moreover, his office boasts a comfortable environment, complete with state-of-the-art technology, that ensures eye appointments are now an enjoyable experience. The impressive selection of eyeglass frames, combined with the accommodating staff, further enhance the overall experience for patients.

input: Overall, the place is cute with great food and a fantastic pear cider beer. The service was excellent, the ambiance was delightful, and the prices were reasonable.
Revise this with your best effort: In general, the establishment is absolutely charming, boasting delectable cuisine and an exquisite selection of pear cider beer. The service provided was truly exceptional, exuding warmth and attentiveness. The atmosphere is simply delightful, contributing to an unforgettable dining experience, and the prices charged are notably fair and reasonable.

input: Seasons is a delightful little restaurant primarily known for its delicious desserts. However, they also offer modernized versions of traditional classics as main courses. The shaved ice at Seasons is unique and their variety of boba tea is excellent. The store is conveniently located with ample parking and a clean, modern, and kid-friendly atmosphere. The service is always friendly, fast, and efficient. While I cannot personally vouch for the food, my boyfriend raves about the quail and our friends love the chicken wings. Overall, I highly recommend visiting Seasons for a satisfying and enjoyable dining experience.
Revise this with your best effort: Seasons is an enchanting eatery that truly shines with its mouthwatering assortment of delectable desserts. However, it goes beyond mere sweet indulgence by serving up innovative renditions of traditional favorites as standout main courses. One of the highlights at Seasons is their delightfully refreshing shaved ice, which boasts a distinctive flair. Additionally, their array of boba tea options is simply exceptional. Situated in a convenient location with plentiful parking, the restaurant offers a clean, contemporary ambiance that is perfect for families, accompanied by a welcoming and kid-friendly atmosphere. The service here is consistently remarkable, exhibiting both warmth and efficiency. While I cannot personally vouch for every dish, my boyfriend can't stop raving about the incredible quail, and our friends simply cannot resist the allure of the delectable chicken wings. In summary, I wholeheartedly recommend paying a visit to Seasons for a truly gratifying and pleasurable dining experience.

input: The place is cute for meeting friends, but overpriced. Personally, I prefer my own homemade coffee. Adorable concept, but products and prices need improvement.
Revise this with your best effort: The venue has a charming atmosphere that's perfect for catching up with friends, although it tends to be on the expensive side. Speaking from personal preference, I find greater satisfaction in brewing my own coffee at home. While the concept is undeniably adorable, there is room for improvement in terms of both the products offered and their pricing.

input: This place is simply amazing! With 75 cent oysters that I couldn't resist, I indulged in 2 dozen before moving on to their delicious cheesy grits. Truly a great spot for dining, especially during happy hour.
Revise this with your best effort: I am absolutely in awe of this place! The irresistible offer of 75 cent oysters lured me in, and I happily indulged in two dozen before proceeding to savor their mouthwatering cheesy grits. Undeniably, this establishment is a haven for dining, particularly during their delightful happy hour.

input: Highly recommend this place! Love the organic, fresh, and delicious food. Variety of options and love that they support local farmers and fishermen. Carly's breakfast is a favorite with avocado, sourdough toast, fried egg, and sweet potatoes. Sooo good!
Revise this with your best effort: I highly recommend this place! The organic, fresh, and incredibly delicious food is simply amazing. The wide variety of options is fantastic, and what sets this place apart is their admirable support for local farmers and fishermen. If you're looking for a breakfast that will blow your taste buds away, Carly's breakfast is an absolute favorite of mine. The combination of avocado, sourdough toast, fried egg, and sweet potatoes is like a flavor symphony in your mouth. Trust me, it's beyond delicious!

input: The burgers at this place are delicious and flavorful, especially the El Mariachi. The portion size might be small, but the taste makes up for it. I highly recommend trying the salted caramel ice cream, it has a great homemade style. Don't forget to add the rooster sauce for an extra kick!
Revise this with your best effort: The burgers served at this establishment are incredibly delectable and bursting with flavor, particularly the El Mariachi option. While the portion sizes might be slightly petite, the exquisite taste more than compensates for it. I enthusiastically suggest indulging in their lusciously homemade-style salted caramel ice cream, which is nothing short of exceptional. And, to further enhance your culinary experience, don't overlook the opportunity to add a dollop of the tantalizing rooster sauce for an additional burst of zing!

input: I had an amazing experience at this place! The sushi was surprisingly delicious and the bill was unbelievably low. For just $13, I devoured a plate full of sushi. The staff was not only friendly, but also seemed to enjoy their work. I had a great time and will definitely be returning soon.
Revise this with your best effort: I had an absolutely incredible experience at this place! The sushi surpassed all expectations, offering a delightful surprise with its delectable flavors. What truly shocked me was the unbelievably low bill I received. For a mere $13, I indulged in a generous plate brimming with heaven-sent sushi. Not only was the staff extremely friendly, but they also exuded a genuine passion for their craft. They ensured that my time there was nothing short of amazing, leaving me with a lingering sense of joy and satisfaction. Without a doubt, I eagerly anticipate my next visit to this remarkable establishment.

input: This place is terrible. The hoagies are greasy and made me nauseous. The buffalo chicken sandwich was covered in too much blue cheese and greasy sauce, which was disgusting. All the food is overly greasy and over seasoned, they need to use fresher ingredients. The desserts are bland and not worth the money. The sodas are usually expired and flat. Overall, I hate everything about this place.
Revise this with your best effort: I am extremely dissatisfied with this establishment. Not only were the hoagies greasy, but they also made me feel nauseated. The buffalo chicken sandwich was drenched in an overwhelming amount of blue cheese and greasy sauce, which was highly unappetizing. It is evident that all the food served here is excessively oily and overly seasoned, highlighting the urgent need for fresher ingredients. Furthermore, the desserts lacked flavor and were not worth their price. To make matters worse, the sodas regularly provided were often expired and flat. Considering these factors, I must firmly express my strong displeasure towards this place and its offerings.

input: Despite paying for a non-smoking room, we were disappointed to find a smell and ashtrays in the room. The slow-draining shower and lumpy pillows were also uncomfortable, resulting in a migraine. On a positive note, the room was clean and the staff was friendly. However, the promised free WiFi didn't connect.
Revise this with your best effort: Despite specifically requesting a non-smoking room, our hopes were shattered when we discovered a lingering smell and ashtrays within the premises. Additionally, the excruciatingly slow-draining shower and uncomfortably lumpy pillows mercilessly inflicted a pounding migraine. Yet, in the midst of these displeasures, it should be acknowledged that the room itself was kept immaculately clean and the staff exhibited remarkable friendliness. Unfortunately, our high expectations were dashed once again as the promised complimentary WiFi failed to establish a reliable connection.

input: The pharmacy staff was unfriendly and provided inconsistent information about prescription wait times. Not recommended if you're in a hurry; consider going to Walmart next door instead.
Revise this with your best effort: The pharmacy team displayed a lack of friendliness, along with inconsistent communication regarding prescription wait times. If prompt service is important to you, it would be advisable to explore the nearby Walmart as an alternative.

input: I love the seitan dishes at El Camino, like the wings and nachos. However, the service can be extremely slow. They once took so long to bring out my nachos that they gave them to me for free. The fried pickles, on the other hand, were disappointing. The coating was too grainy and the taste didn't appeal to me. Despite these drawbacks, the delicious seitan and decent margaritas keep me returning to El Camino.
Revise this with your best effort: I am a huge fan of El Camino's seitan offerings, particularly their mouthwatering wings and delectable nachos. However, I do have one gripe - their service can be quite sluggish at times. On one occasion, I had to wait an exorbitant amount of time for my nachos, but to their credit, they were kind enough to comp them for the delay. Regrettably, the fried pickles left much to be desired. The coating had an unpleasant grainy texture and the flavor simply didn't suit my taste. Despite these minor setbacks, the irresistible seitan dishes and their reasonably enjoyable margaritas continue to lure me back to El Camino.

input: I highly recommend B13 for tattoos. I've had two done there and both turned out amazing. The owner was able to accommodate a group of us on short notice with an impressive design. Amanda's work is particularly outstanding, although the entire team is fantastic.
Revise this with your best effort: I wholeheartedly suggest B13 as the go-to place for tattoos. I have personally experienced their exceptional artistry on two occasions, and the results were nothing short of amazing. The owner efficiently arranged a last-minute appointment for our group, presenting a truly impressive design. While the whole team at B13 is fantastic, I must commend Amanda for her truly outstanding work.

input: Went on a busy Friday night with a 20 min wait. Service was hit and miss, though the server tried their best. Food was okay, but not impressive. Unlikely to return, it just didn't stand out.
Revise this with your best effort: On a bustling Friday night, I decided to venture into this establishment despite a modest 20-minute wait. The service presented a mixed bag, albeit with the server's sincere attempts to please. As for the cuisine, it was passable but failed to make a lasting impression. Regrettably, I find it unlikely that I will choose to return as it simply did not distinguish itself from the crowd.

input: I highly recommend Twisted Twig for all your floral needs. Jen provides excellent service, is very friendly, and creates amazing arrangements. She worked within my budget and delivered exactly what I wanted for my wedding. I was pleasantly surprised by her attention to detail and the extra touches she added to make everything perfect. You will not be disappointed working with Jen at Twisted Twig.
Revise this with your best effort: I wholeheartedly endorse Twisted Twig for all of your floral needs. Jen, the owner, goes above and beyond to provide exceptional service, ensuring customers are met with a warm and friendly atmosphere. Her ability to craft breathtaking arrangements is truly remarkable. What sets her apart is her incredible willingness to accommodate various budgets, effortlessly delivering exactly what I had envisioned for my wedding. Jen's meticulous attention to detail and the thoughtfulness she puts into every arrangement surpassed my expectations. Working with her was an absolute delight and I guarantee you won't be anything short of thrilled when partnering with Jen at Twisted Twig.

input: Overall, the restaurant had some great dishes like the seaweed salad, shiomay, and sashimi which were fresh and delicious. However, the service was lacking as our waiter was unfriendly and made assumptions about our order. While the banzai roll was unique and tasty, the salad dressing tasted more like carrot purée. One star was deducted due to the subpar service.
Revise this with your best effort: In general, the restaurant offered a variety of delightful dishes such as the refreshing and flavorful seaweed salad, delectable shiomay, and scrumptious sashimi, all of which were undoubtedly fresh and delicious. However, the only downside to our experience was the disappointing service, with our waiter displaying an unfriendly demeanor and wrongly assuming certain aspects of our order. Although the banzai roll stood out for its unique and palatable taste, the salad dressing left much to be desired, more closely resembling a carrot purée. Consequently, we deducted one star from our rating due to the underwhelming service.

input: I recently discovered this hidden gem for brunch and was blown away. Despite living so close, I had never heard of it before. The honeybee crepe and almond croissant were absolutely delicious, leaving nothing for leftovers. The seating area is cozy, but it's best to arrive early if you're with a group. Perfect for smaller groups and I will definitely be returning.
Revise this with your best effort: I recently stumbled upon this incredibly charming spot for brunch and my experience was simply mind-blowing. Even though I live in such close proximity, I had never even heard of it before. The honeybee crepe and almond croissant that I indulged in were undeniably delectable, leaving no trace of leftovers behind. While the seating area may be relatively snug, it is highly advisable to secure an early arrival if you plan to dine with a group. This hidden gem is particularly suited for intimate gatherings and I am already eagerly anticipating my next visit.

input: Best location ever! Donuts are made to order, and after 5pm they are always super hot and incredibly tasty. Even the next day, they remain delicious.
Revise this with your best effort: The ultimate destination! Indulge in made-to-order donuts that are irresistibly delectable. At all times, especially after 5pm, they are served piping hot and bursting with incredible flavors. Don't worry if you can't finish them all because even the next day, their deliciousness remains unmatched.

input: Highly recommended! This place is adorable and sustainable. The staff is amazing, and the food and coffee are extraordinary.
Revise this with your best effort: I highly recommend this place! It is absolutely adorable and has a strong commitment to sustainability. The staff is truly exceptional, going above and beyond to ensure a remarkable experience. Moreover, the food and coffee surpass expectations, elevated to an extraordinary level.

input: Horrible food quality and overpriced, coupled with a frustrating two-hour delivery time and rude customer service over the phone. Regrettable choice to order from this establishment, definitely won't be repeating the experience.
Revise this with your best effort: The food quality is abysmal and grossly overpriced. Additionally, the frustrating two-hour delivery time and the uncivilized customer service over the phone only add to the regrettable experience. Without a doubt, I will never make the mistake of ordering from this establishment again.

input: I absolutely love Evan! He is the best guy ever and the reason I come to OMALLZ.
Revise this with your best effort: I have an immense admiration for Evan! He is undeniably an exceptional individual and the very essence of why I am drawn to OMALLZ.

input: Disappointing experience - tasteless burger, soggy bun, and overly salty fries. Overpriced for the quality. Won't return.
Revise this with your best effort: Extremely dissatisfying encounter - burger devoid of taste, bun rendered soggy, and fries excessively salted. The price charged far exceeded the offered quality, leaving much to be desired. Regrettably, my future visits are out of the question.

input: I was pleasantly surprised to discover a Taiwanese restaurant in Reno, conveniently located near all of the hotels. The boba tea was solid, and they offer authentic Taiwanese food choices if you know what to order.
Revise this with your best effort: To my delight, I stumbled upon a Taiwanese eatery nestled in the heart of Reno, mere minutes away from the bustling hotels. The strength of their boba tea was astonishing, and for those in the know, a treasure trove of genuine Taiwanese culinary delights awaits.

input: This restaurant is a complete disappointment and not worth your money. Despite dining here twice, we've had such terrible experiences that corporate had to refund us. It's clear that this place is clueless and you will only be ripped off.
Revise this with your best effort: I regret to inform you that this restaurant has failed to meet expectations on multiple occasions and is not deserving of your hard-earned money. Despite giving it two chances, our dining experiences have been absolutely dreadful, resulting in corporate having to step in and issue refunds. It is evident that this establishment lacks basic understanding of quality service and will undoubtedly leave you feeling cheated.

input: I was pleasantly surprised by this place. Despite my initial hesitation as a vegetarian, they offer a delicious veggie burger and a great variety of local microbrews. Don't miss out on their homemade ice cream! I'll definitely be returning when I'm in St. Louis again.
Revise this with your best effort: I was genuinely delighted by my experience at this place. Initially cautious as a vegetarian, I was pleasantly surprised to discover their delectable veggie burger and an impressive selection of locally brewed, microbrews. Oh, and you absolutely cannot pass up on their divine homemade ice cream! Without a doubt, I will make it a point to return upon my next visit to St. Louis.

input: Zaika is a hidden gem for Indian food lovers. The fresh ingredients and attention to detail in their dishes set them apart from other Indo-Pak places. The Paneer is silky and flavorful, and even their vegetarian options are so delicious that you won't miss the meat. The appetizers are well-spiced and reminiscent of homemade meals. The naan is perfectly cooked, though it lacks the faint sweetness it's known for. The extensive menu makes ordering easy, and their catering services are highly praised. Overall, Zaika offers a delightful dining experience, and their Ras Malai dessert is a must-try.
Revise this with your best effort: Zaika truly stands out as a hidden gem for those who adore Indian cuisine. With a passionate commitment to using fresh ingredients and impeccable attention to detail in their dishes, this establishment sets itself apart from other Indo-Pak eateries. The Paneer, in particular, captivates with its velvety texture and tantalizing flavors, leaving you content even if you opt for their vegetarian alternatives. The appetizers boast a well-balanced spiciness that evokes memories of homemade meals and adds to the overall allure. While their naan is perfectly cooked, it mildly disappoints by lacking the subtle sweetness it is renowned for. The extensive menu effortlessly guides you through the ordering process, ensuring a seamless experience, and their highly acclaimed catering services further solidify Zaika's credibility. A visit to this restaurant guarantees a delightful dining affair, and indulging in their irresistible Ras Malai dessert is an absolute must.

input: This bustling restaurant exceeded our expectations with its special coffee, attentive service, accommodating for dietary restrictions, and delectable dishes. The presentation and pricing were both satisfactory. We highly recommend this restaurant.
Revise this with your best effort: We were thoroughly impressed by this bustling restaurant, as it went above and beyond our expectations. Moreover, the restaurant made sure to cater to our dietary restrictions, showing a commendable level of accommodation. The dishes served were absolutely delectable, leaving us yearning for more. Additionally, both the presentation and pricing of the food were satisfactory, further enhancing our dining experience. Without hesitation, we wholeheartedly recommend this outstanding restaurant.

input: I highly recommend this place! The staff is incredibly friendly and great with kids. The food, especially the hash browns, is amazing. You can also try their delicious tomatoes and grits on the side. Best of all, it's budget-friendly.
Revise this with your best effort: I cannot recommend this place enough! The staff goes above and beyond with their incredible friendliness and exceptional ability to interact with children. The food, particularly the hash browns, is absolutely outstanding. Pair it with their delightful tomatoes and grits for a complete and satisfying meal. What makes this place even more appealing is its affordability, fitting comfortably within any budget.

input: The gelato at this place is delicious, but the service is extremely poor. Revise this with your best effort: The gelato offered at this establishment is undeniably delicious, however, regrettably, the level of service provided leaves much to be desired. input: Fantastic location for outdoor activities like hiking, biking, and running with well-maintained paths, stunning views, and shady spots. However, the only drawback is people not adhering to the dogs on leash rule, with at least 6 off-leash dogs encountered. It's crucial to follow the rules; otherwise, they might ban dogs altogether.

The paths are impeccably maintained, granting a seamless experience as you traverse through breathtaking vistas and shaded havens. input: I highly recommend this place! The crab cake appetizer was delicious with a refreshing dill sauce. The chicken tenders were generous in portion and satisfying. The service was fine, although it can get busy at times. The prices were unbelievably reasonable. The ambiance is nice and overall, it's a lovely option for great food at a reasonable price.
Revise this with your best effort: I strongly urge you to consider visiting this establishment! The delightful crab cake appetizer served with a rejuvenating dill sauce was a true culinary delight. The generously portioned and deeply gratifying chicken tenders will leave you fully content. While the service may occasionally be affected by busyness, the prices are incredibly affordable and provide unbeatable value. The pleasant ambiance contributes to an overall enchanting dining experience, making it an exceptional choice for delectable fare at an affordable cost.

input: Outstanding service, delicious food & friendly staff. Constant promotions keep us coming back. Incredible fish quality & well-proportioned rolls allow for diverse selection. Our go-to sushi spot in town!
Revise this with your best effort: Our go-to sushi spot in town! From outstanding service to delicious food and friendly staff, this place has it all. They constantly offer promotions that keep us coming back for more. The fish quality is truly incredible, and the rolls are well-proportioned, allowing for a diverse selection.

input: My boyfriend and I tried Jesse's for the first time and had a great experience. Despite being busy, we were seated quickly by the window. The server, Nikki, was prompt and knowledgeable. The appetizers and soups were tasty, although the crab stuffed mushrooms were small. The Caesar salads were good and the pacing of the meal was perfect. The steaks were cooked perfectly, but there weren't enough sautéed mushrooms. Overall, Nikki's service was fantastic and we definitely plan to return.
Revise this with your best effort:
My boyfriend and I recently dined at Jesse's for the first time, and it exceeded our expectations in every way. Despite the restaurant being bustling with activity, we were impressed by how quickly we were seated by a cozy window table. Our server, Nikki, proved to be both attentive and well-informed, ensuring that our dining experience was nothing short of exceptional.

The appetizers and soups we ordered were bursting with flavor, though I must admit that the crab stuffed mushrooms were a tad on the petite side. Nonetheless, the Caesar salads we enjoyed were delicious, and the timing between the different courses was impeccable, allowing us to savor each dish.

The highlight of our meal undoubtedly came with the arrival of our steaks. Prepared to perfection, they were succulent and cooked exactly as requested. However, I must point out that the portion of sautéed mushrooms accompanying the steaks left us yearning for a bit more.

Despite this minor setback, we were thoroughly impressed by Nikki's exceptional service throughout the evening. Her attentiveness and knowledge of the menu made our dining experience all the more enjoyable. We left Jesse's with no doubt in our minds that we will be returning in the future to savor more of their delectable cuisine.

input: The staff was friendly, the selection was good, and the prices were fair.
Revise this with your best effort: The staff exhibited remarkable friendliness, the selection boasted impressive variety, and the prices were undoubtedly fair.

input: I had a disappointing experience at The Praline Connection in New Orleans. The BBQ Oysters were served in a soup cup with a bland "BBQ sauce" and had a gooey texture. The garlic bread tasted stale and frozen, and the appetizers were cold and appeared microwaved. The Chicken wings were undercooked, cold, and had an unpleasant sauce. The rest of our party also found their entrees unsatisfactory. The only positives were the great service and the clean, pleasant ambiance. I would not recommend this restaurant to anyone.
Revise this with your best effort: I had an extremely unsatisfying encounter at The Praline Connection in New Orleans. To start, the BBQ Oysters were served in a soup cup and drizzled with a tasteless "BBQ sauce", leaving them with an unappetizing, gooey texture. The garlic bread, unfortunately, had a stale and frozen aftertaste, and the appetizers were served cold, giving the impression that they had been hastily microwaved. Moreover, the Chicken wings were poorly cooked, still cold on the inside, and accompanied by an unpleasant sauce. Regrettably, the disappointments extended to the entrees of our entire group. However, it must be acknowledged that the service provided to us was exceptional, and the restaurant itself had a nicely maintained and inviting atmosphere. Despite these few positives, I cannot in good faith recommend this restaurant to anyone based on the multitude of shortcomings we encountered during our visit.

input: This McDonald's location near my home is terrible. The food is consistently bad, cold, or incorrect. The service is slow, and many employees do not speak English, making communication difficult. I recommend avoiding this location unless you have plenty of time and can speak Spanish.
Revise this with your best effort: The McDonald's establishment near my residence is severely lacking in quality. input: The breakfast was outstanding, conveniently located near our hotel. The crepes with fruit were delicious and definitely worth ordering again. However, the tea had a slight taste of fennel seed, which could be a hit or miss for some.
Revise this with your best effort: The breakfast at this conveniently located eatery near our hotel was truly exceptional. input: Attended a Yelp Elite event at Holy Mole and had an amazing time! The food was incredible, especially the specially crafted cocktail. The staff was attentive and friendly. Can't wait to come back for a full meal!

input: My experience at Dinardo's was unpleasant and disappointing. The interior was run down and unclean, and the food quality did not match the high prices. Revise this with your best effort:
My visit to Dinardo's left me feeling incredibly dissatisfied and disheartened. Upon entering, I couldn't help but notice the deteriorated and unhygienic state of the interior, instantly dampening my expectations. Sadly, the exorbitant prices did not align with the disappointing quality of the food offered. To exacerbate matters, the server’s snide remarks only contributed to the already inhospitable ambiance.

Additionally, they have a fantastic bakery, coffee, and gelato counter, providing instant service or treats to enjoy while waiting.
Revise this with your best effort: This restaurant is the perfect choice for entertaining out-of-town guests, particularly for a delightful breakfast or brunch experience. On weekends, it tends to become quite bustling, resulting in wait times of over an hour after 9:30 AM, and the service may be slightly sluggish. Nonetheless, the extensive menu offerings and mouthwatering cuisine effortlessly compensate for the wait. Moreover, they boast an exceptional bakery, coffee, and gelato counter, ensuring quick service and delightful treats to savor while patiently waiting your turn.

input: The food is excellent, but the service was disappointing and made me feel rushed and unimportant. Shocked that the waitress withheld my change, leaving me feeling cheated. Will consider returning in the future with exact change and adjusted tip due to the experience.
Revise this with your best effort: The quality of the food was exceptional; however, I found the service to be quite disappointing, leaving me with a sense of being rushed and undervalued. I was taken aback when the waitress failed to return my change, which left me feeling somewhat deceived. Despite this, I may contemplate giving this place another chance in the future, ensuring to bring exact change and adjust the tip accordingly, all because of my previous encounter.

input: The sushi at this place is solid, with Mesa rolls being my personal favorite. However, the pick-up service needs improvement as they often give inaccurate estimations, causing delays. I would rate them 4 stars if this issue was resolved.
Revise this with your best effort: The sushi served at this establishment is commendable, and I find myself particularly fond of their Mesa rolls. Nonetheless, the pick-up service falls short and would greatly benefit from some enhancements, especially in regards to providing more accurate estimations, as this tends to cause unnecessary delays. If this matter were to be addressed and resolved, I would gladly rate their performance at four stars.

input: The best burger in Philly. Fresh bread, juicy meat, friendly service, and affordable price.
Revise this with your best effort: Experience the pinnacle of burger perfection in Philadelphia: The divine creation known as the best burger in Philly. Sink your teeth into a delightfully soft, freshly baked bread that perfectly complements the superstar - juicy, mouthwatering meat that will leave you craving for more. Be captivated by the warm hospitality and amiable service that awaits you, ensuring a memorable dining experience. And the cherry on top? All of this comes at a price that won't break the bank, making it an absolute steal. Embrace the deliciousness, succumb to the charm, and savor the unbeatable combination of fresh bread, tantalizing meat, friendly service, and affordable price.

input: This place is a great spot for wine, cheese, and outdoor music. However, the food was unremarkable, particularly the bacon-wrapped dates, brussel sprouts, and sardines that were sent back due to their unpleasant smell and taste.
Revise this with your best effort: This location is an ideal destination for wine enthusiasts, cheese connoisseurs, and those seeking outdoor music. Nevertheless, the culinary offerings left much to be desired, especially the disappointing bacon-wrapped dates, lackluster brussel sprouts, and the off-putting scent and flavor of the sardines, which had to be returned.

input: The Po-Boys were excellent in taste but lacked sufficient catfish, quite skimpy. Yet, the service was very good.
Revise this with your best effort: The flavor of the Po-Boys was absolutely delightful, however, it left something to be desired in terms of catfish quantity as it was quite scarce. Nonetheless, I must commend the service for being exceptional.

input: I had the worst Mediterranean food experience. The hummus was drowned in an excessive amount of olive oil, and the pita bread was burnt to the point of being black. The food made me sick because of the overwhelming oil content. The manager's behavior was terrible too, offering a "favor" with a condescending tone and yelling from across the restaurant instead of talking to us. We didn't feel comfortable giving feedback due to his negative attitude. The sign claiming the "cleanest bathroom in town" was the only positive takeaway.
Revise this with your best effort:
I had an incredibly disappointing Mediterranean food experience that left much to be desired. The hummus, which is usually a delightful part of the meal, was unfortunately drowned in an excessive amount of olive oil, completely overpowering its flavors. As if that weren't enough, the pita bread served alongside it was disappointingly burnt to a crisp, almost blackened. Not only did this ruin the taste, but it also made me feel sick due to the overwhelming oil content.

To make matters worse, the behavior of the manager was abysmal. Instead of addressing our concerns professionally, he offered a so-called "favor" in a condescending tone, even resorting to shouting from across the restaurant, rather than approaching us directly. This lack of proper communication and overall negative attitude made it incredibly uncomfortable for us to provide any feedback.

On a slightly positive note, the one takeaway from this experience was the sign claiming the "cleanest bathroom in town". Despite the disappointments with the food and the manager, at least they were successful in maintaining a clean restroom.

input: The bagels are great but it's disappointing they close early. Staff could be friendlier, but the tasty bagels make up for it!
Revise this with your best effort: The bagels offered are truly remarkable, though it can be disappointing that they close their doors early. The staff's demeanor could benefit from a friendlier approach, but the delectable bagels unquestionably compensate for any shortcomings in service.

input: The hotel was fantastic, with a great location and friendly staff. The room was spacious and impeccably clean, with a well-stocked kitchenette. The natural light from the windows surrounding the bed was a plus. Opting out of housekeeping also gave a $5 credit at the restaurant. The pool was small, but the hot tub was always available. The bar had a decent drink selection, although they were out of mint for a mojito. The burger was okay, and the dessert was mediocre but free with the credit. The breakfast spread was nice, although the coffee was weak and often had grounds in it.
Revise this with your best effort:
The hotel exceeded all expectations, boasting a phenomenal location and a staff that exuded warmth and friendliness. The room itself was not only spacious but also maintained an impeccable level of cleanliness, including a well-equipped kitchenette that was fully stocked. The abundant natural light that flooded in through the windows surrounding the bed was an added bonus, creating a pleasant and inviting atmosphere.

Choosing to forgo housekeeping during our stay also came with its perks, providing us with a generous $5 credit that we could utilize at the restaurant. Although the pool was on the smaller side, the presence of a readily available hot tub more than made up for it, ensuring ultimate relaxation.

While the bar offered a decent selection of drinks, it was regrettable that they had run out of mint for the signature mojito. The burger served at the hotel's restaurant was passable, and the dessert left much to be desired, however, it was satisfying to know that it was complimentary with the credit we had received.

The breakfast spread offered an array of delectable options, pleasing to the eye and palate alike. Unfortunately, the only flaw was the coffee, which appeared to be weak and frequently contained grounds, detracting slightly from an otherwise enjoyable start to the day.

input: The falafel wrap was average, but slightly overpriced. The ambiance of the sitting area was unappealing, resembling a cold and unwelcoming cave. Manayunk offers better dining options.
Revise this with your best effort: The falafel wrap was decent, albeit a bit overpriced. The ambiance of the seating area unfortunately lacked appeal, resembling a chilly and unwelcoming cave. When it comes to dining options, Manayunk undoubtedly offers superior choices.

input: I had a great experience at this place when I needed assistance due to a flat tire and car damage while driving cross country. Brian was very friendly, quickly assessed the situation, and fixed everything within 30 minutes. Highly recommend!
Revise this with your best effort: I had an exceptional experience at this establishment when I found myself in need of assistance due to a flat tire and car damage while on a cross-country drive. Brian, the remarkable individual at this location, displayed a remarkable level of friendliness as he promptly assessed the situation at hand. To my utmost satisfaction, he diligently resolved all the issues within a mere timeframe of 30 minutes. I wholeheartedly endorse this place without hesitation or reservation.

input: Visited this eatery with a party of 8 on Friday, July 22. Great location for exploring the Quarter afterwards. Unfortunately, only 2 out of the 8 dishes ordered were tasty - the jambalaya and file gumbo. The rest, including red beans and rice, meatloaf, Mac and cheese, shrimp po boy, and chicken wings, were bland and a waste of money. The staff was nice, but overall the food was mediocre.
Revise this with your best effort: On Friday, July 22, my party of 8 had the opportunity to dine at this charming eatery, which is conveniently located for exploring the Quarter afterwards. Regrettably, only a mere 2 out of the 8 dishes that were ordered managed to delight our taste buds - the impeccably flavored jambalaya and delectable file gumbo. Disappointingly, the remaining dishes, such as the red beans and rice, meatloaf, Mac and cheese, shrimp po boy, and chicken wings, lacked the desired flavors and were frankly a regrettable waste of our hard-earned money. Although the staff members were pleasant and accommodating, the overall quality of the food unfortunately fell short of our expectations, earning it a rather mediocre rating.

input: Santa Barbara's seafood market offers an unbeatable freshness, rivaling the renowned Tokyo fish market. Despite lacking ambiance, the ocean view from the outdoor seating compensates for it. Delight in a wide selection of delectable shellfish, tailored to satisfy your cravings. Although you might face a wait during busy times, the experience is undoubtedly worthwhile. Use the wait to explore the nearby pier and make space for the mouthwatering feast that awaits you.
Revise this with your best effort: Santa Barbara's seafood market boasts an unparalleled level of freshness that rivals even the esteemed Tokyo fish market. While the market may lack a certain ambiance, the breathtaking ocean view from the outdoor seating more than makes up for it. Indulge in a diverse and appetizing array of shellfish, expertly prepared to satisfy your every craving. Though you may encounter a wait during peak times, the overall experience is undeniably worth it. Take advantage of this time to explore the nearby pier, allowing yourself to make room for the imminent and tantalizing feast that awaits you.

input: This place offers creative and tasty food, decent house wines, and well-made but small cocktails. Service has always been good, although I haven't been during peak times. The patio is a great spot for hanging out with friends.
Revise this with your best effort: With its tantalizing and imaginative menu, this establishment offers a delectable array of culinary creations that are sure to impress. The selection of house wines is both respectable and enjoyable, while the meticulously crafted cocktails, though smaller in size, boast exceptional quality. The service has consistently exceeded expectations, although I must admit that I have yet to experience it during busier periods. The inviting patio, adorned with its charming ambiance, provides the perfect setting for spending delightful moments with cherished friends.

input: Skyway Cafe (formerly Skyway Jacks) offers huge plates of delicious food at affordable prices. The bovine decor provides a cozy atmosphere, reminiscent of a local diner. The service is prompt and the coffee keeps flowing. Don't miss their morning breakfast deal for a satisfying start to your day. And most importantly, the banana pecan pancakes are a must-try. Trust me, you won't be disappointed.
Revise this with your best effort: Skyway Cafe (formerly known as Skyway Jacks) is a delightful eatery that guarantees immense portions of delectable cuisine without breaking the bank. The charming ambiance enriched by bovine-themed decorations evokes a comforting local diner vibe, making it the perfect place to relax. The attentive service ensures you won't be left waiting, and the coffee flows abundantly to keep you satisfied. Be sure not to overlook their irresistible morning breakfast deal, perfect for kickstarting an absolutely gratifying day. However, the true showstopper lies in their must-try banana pecan pancakes. Prepare to indulge your taste buds and trust me, you simply won't be left unimpressed.

input: Terrible experience! Waited over an hour for a shot, only to be told they were closing the line. Complete disappointment. Avoid this place.
Revise this with your best effort: Absolutely dreadful encounter! I endured an agonizing wait of over an hour for a simple shot, only to be devastatingly informed that they were abruptly closing the line. Utterly disheartening and dismaying. I strongly urge everyone to steer clear of this establishment.

input: Extremely disappointed with the customer service. Don't count on finding any assistance, good luck.
Revise this with your best effort: I am extremely disappointed with the level of customer service provided. It is highly unlikely that you will receive any assistance, so good luck with your endeavors

input: Fair Grinds in New Orleans is a quaint and hipster coffee shop with a beautiful outdoor seating area. The small cold brew with vanilla and gluten-free zucchini bread were delicious. The option of adding whole milk was a rare and enjoyable treat. However, the limited gluten-free offerings were disappointing. Overall, a great place to visit if in the neighborhood.
Revise this with your best effort: Fair Grinds in New Orleans is a charming and trendy coffee shop boasting an enchanting outdoor seating area. The small cold brew infused with vanilla and accompanied by a delectable slice of gluten-free zucchini bread was truly delightful. The rare option of adding whole milk to my beverage was a delightful and indulgent treat. However, I found the selection of gluten-free options to be disappointingly limited. Nevertheless, Fair Grinds remains a fantastic destination to explore, particularly if you happen to find yourself in the neighborhood.

input: I absolutely loved this place! The sweet selection is incredible, especially the gooey butter cookies and the German chocolate cupcake. Highly recommend!
Revise this with your best effort: I can't express enough how much I adored this place! The array of sweet treats available is truly out of this world, with the gooey butter cookies and the luscious German chocolate cupcake stealing the show. I cannot recommend it enough!

input: Decent frozen yogurt with ample topping choices and a variety of flavors. However, costs can escalate when weighing your cup. Limited seating inside and the staff lacks energy. Bubble tea was unimpressive.
Revise this with your best effort: The frozen yogurt offered at this establishment is of good quality, accompanied by a generous selection of toppings and an extensive range of flavors to choose from. It is worth noting that expenses may increase depending on the weight of your cup. Additionally, the seating capacity inside is somewhat limited and the staff could benefit from a more enthusiastic demeanor. Furthermore, it is regrettable to mention that the bubble tea did not leave a lasting impression.

input: Amazing food and worth the drive! Authentic Taiwanese cuisine. Loved the Chicken Basil and their Boba Tea is great too! Don't listen to the negative reviews, try it and judge for yourself!
Revise this with your best effort: You won't be disappointed with the incredible food and it's worth the drive! Experience the true flavors of Taiwan with their authentic cuisine. The Chicken Basil is an absolute standout, and their Boba Tea is simply fantastic. Forget about any negative reviews and give it a try; let your own taste buds be the judge!

input: CRU is a charming wine bar with a modern atmosphere. The wine flight and food options were delicious, with the Farmers Plate being a standout. I loved the cozy and quaint feel of the place and can't wait to return.
Revise this with your best effort: CRU exudes a captivating charm as a wine bar, boasting an impeccable modern atmosphere. The delectable wine flight and enticing food options surpass expectations, with the Farmers Plate being an absolute standout. The ambience of the venue is irresistibly cozy and quaint, leaving a lasting impression that fuels an overwhelming eagerness to revisit.

input: I've been a loyal customer for years, and this spot remains truly great. In my opinion, it offers one of the top 3 steaks in the city. Even after a name change, the quality has stayed consistent. For a delicious twist, I highly recommend trying their chicken cheesesteak.
Revise this with your best effort: As a dedicated patron for numerous years, I can confidently attest to the enduring excellence of this establishment. In my personal estimation, it undeniably ranks among the city's top three destinations for indulging in a sumptuous steak. Impressively, despite undergoing a name change, the unwavering commitment to delivering top-notch quality has remained unwavering. If you desire to experience a delectable and unique offering, I enthusiastically suggest savoring their tantalizing chicken cheesesteak.

input: Pina's in Roxborough is a highly underrated place to eat. Their stromboli and sicilian pie are both top-notch, but the sandwiches and pizza are just average. The chicken park dish is a standout, with a generous portion size and mouthwatering flavors. Overall, Pina's is a satisfying and filling dining option.
Revise this with your best effort: Pina's in Roxborough is an extraordinary hidden gem for food enthusiasts. Not only do they craft phenomenal stromboli and sicilian pie, but their sandwiches and pizza also offer immensely palatable experiences. Nevertheless, it is the chicken park dish that steals the spotlight, flaunting an abundance of flavors that will leave you craving more. The generous portion size of this delectable delight guarantees a gratifying and satiating dining adventure. When seeking a fulfilling meal, Pina's unquestionably surpasses expectations.

input: Overall, this cafe offers tasty food and a wide variety of options at their grocery section. Although slightly expensive, the quality justifies the price. I particularly enjoyed their vegan sandwich and tofu melt, accompanied by an extensive assortment of vegan desserts.
Revise this with your best effort: In general, this cafe provides delectable food and an extensive range of options in their grocery section. While it may be slightly pricey, the exceptional quality truly warrants the cost. Personally, I relished their vegan sandwich and tofu melt, complemented by a diverse selection of vegan desserts.

input: This place is amazing! They serve the best burgers in New Orleans with excellent service. The food is fresh, and they make sure you are served promptly. We tried the Gator and deer burgers, which were delicious. Personally, I loved their buffalo wings. Their drinks are also great. We left extremely satisfied and will definitely return before leaving town.
Revise this with your best effort: I am absolutely blown away by this establishment! Not only do they offer the most delectable burgers in all of New Orleans, but their service is truly unparalleled. Each dish is crafted with the utmost care, ensuring the use of fresh, high-quality ingredients. Promptness is a priority here, as they take great strides to serve their patrons in a timely manner. My companions and I had the pleasure of indulging in the Gator and deer burgers, whose flavors were simply out of this world. I must confess, however, that my heart belongs to their heavenly buffalo wings. Accompanying these magnificent eats are their superb drink selections, which perfectly enhance the overall dining experience. Departing this incredible place, our hearts and bellies were filled with immense satisfaction, and it is without a doubt that we shall make a point to revisit before bidding farewell to this remarkable city.

input: Highly recommend this restaurant! Great old school atmosphere with 3 floors. The food is amazing, especially the veal, clams casino, mussles, pasta, and homemade garlic bread. The staff is friendly and helpful. Recently tried the gnocchi with gorgonzola sauce and it became my new favorite dish. A must-visit place for food lovers!
Revise this with your best effort: I highly recommend visiting this fantastic restaurant! It boasts a delightful old school atmosphere spread across three floors. The food offered here is simply amazing, particularly their mouthwatering veal, clams casino, mussels, pasta, and the delectable homemade garlic bread. The staff is incredibly friendly and always ready to assist. During my recent visit, I had the pleasure of trying their gnocchi with gorgonzola sauce, and it instantly became my new favorite dish. Without a doubt, this place is a must-visit for all food enthusiasts!

input: Home Wine Kitchen's "No Menu Monday" is a must-try for food enthusiasts in St. Louis. The three-course meal, priced at $30, offers delicious and customized dishes. The starters, lamb meatballs and goat cheese-stuffed peppers, were excellent. The mains, corvina fish and swordfish steak, were tasty, although the corvina was slightly too complex for my taste. Dessert, champagne gelatin and chocolate tart, was delightful. The staff was friendly and professional, and the ambiance was pleasant. Overall, a great dining experience, but I am curious to try their regular menu next time.
Revise this with your best effort: If you are a food enthusiast in St. Louis, you absolutely cannot miss out on Home Wine Kitchen's "No Menu Monday." Priced at $30, this three-course meal offers a delightful array of delicious and personalized dishes. The starters, including lamb meatballs and goat cheese-stuffed peppers, were truly excellent. Moving on to the mains, the corvina fish and swordfish steak were both tasty, although I found the corvina to be slightly too intricate for my personal preferences. As for dessert, the combination of champagne gelatin and chocolate tart was simply delightful. The staff at Home Wine Kitchen was not only friendly but also highly professional, contributing to the overall pleasant ambiance. Without a doubt, it was a fantastic dining experience, but now I am even more curious to explore their regular menu next time.

input: I went to this swanky restaurant for a special reunion dinner with friends. The food was worth the price, but my party thought it was expensive. I had the lobster bake which was delicious, although not fantastic. The Neopolitan Old Fashion was made perfectly. My friends ordered various dishes and drinks, and the bill was $170, which some of them found unexpected. The waiter was fantastic, very attentive and even surprised us with a birthday dessert. Service gets 5 stars, food gets 3 stars, ambience gets 4 stars, and price gets 2 stars. Overall, I was satisfied.
Revise this with your best effort: I attended a high-end restaurant to celebrate a special reunion with my friends. While the quality of the food justified its price, some members of my party found it to be on the expensive side. Personally, I opted for the lobster bake, which was delectable albeit not extraordinary. The Neopolitan Old Fashioned cocktail was expertly crafted and thoroughly satisfying. As for my friends, they ordered a variety of dishes and drinks, leading to a bill of $170, which took some of them by surprise. Nonetheless, our waiter provided exceptional service, showing great attentiveness and even surprising us with a delightful birthday dessert. I would rate the service as 5 stars, the food as 3 stars, the ambience as 4 stars, and the price as 2 stars. Overall, I left the restaurant feeling content with my experience.

input: I have been going to Susanna Foo since I was 6 months old and have fond memories of the restaurant. The food is reliable but lacks excitement for me as an adult. The service, decor, and ambience are always impeccable. I hope Susanna adds new flavors or embraces her Chinese roots for a more ethnic menu. I am hopeful for a revitalization and to rekindle my love for Susanna Foo.
Revise this with your best effort: I have been a loyal patron of Susanna Foo from the tender age of 6 months, and my memories of the restaurant are filled with fondness. While the food has always been consistent, it no longer sparks the same excitement as I have grown into adulthood. However, the impeccable service, exquisite decor, and captivating ambience have remained consistently top-notch. In order to reignite my passion for Susanna Foo, I eagerly await a burst of new flavors that push the boundaries or a bold embrace of her Chinese roots to create a more authentically ethnic menu. I hold an optimistic hope for a revitalization, anticipating the opportunity to rekindle the deep love I once had for Susanna Foo.

input: Spiro's is a hidden gem in California with delicious Greek food. Despite its small advertisement, the restaurant offers a delightful dining experience. The Greek lemon soup was excellent and the Moussaka was satisfying. The waiter's suggestion of Sea Bass was also tempting. Overall, the dinner was terrific and the exceptional service from Neil makes Spiro's a must-visit restaurant in the area.
Revise this with your best effort: Spiro's, a hidden gem in California, boasts a delectable array of Greek cuisine that is sure to leave taste buds tantalized. Though its advertising may be modest, this restaurant offers an unforgettable dining experience. The Greek lemon soup, bursting with flavors and fragrances, is a sheer delight, while the Moussaka will satisfy even the most discerning palate. And with the waiter's tempting suggestion of the succulent Sea Bass, one cannot resist diving in. The overall dining experience at Spiro's is simply terrific, but what truly sets it apart is the exceptional service provided by Neil. His attentiveness and genuine care make Spiro's a restaurant that simply must be experienced when in the area.

input: As a BBQ judge, I have to say this is not barbecue in any region, be it Texas, the southeast, or KC. The brisket is more like fatty pot roast, lacking smoke flavor and with a mushy texture. My sandwich was majorly fat-filled, with meatless chunks of fat. It seems either the owner doesn't care or the staff lacks knowledge. Unfortunately, you can find much better BBQ elsewhere.
Revise this with your best effort: As a BBQ judge, I must express that what I experienced does not align with true barbecue from any region, such as Texas, the southeast, or KC. Regrettably, the brisket seemed more akin to a fatty pot roast, lacking that distinct smoky flavor and possessing a disappointingly mushy texture. Moreover, my sandwich was overwhelmingly filled with tasteless chunks of fat, lacking the presence of actual meat. It appears that either the owner lacks passion or the staff lacks expertise in the art of barbecuing. Unfortunately, there are far superior BBQ options available in other places that I would recommend exploring instead.

input: This place is an ideal spot to catch a sunset. A bit of a drive from Tampa but definitely worth it. The energetic music and lively ambiance make it enjoyable. The rocky beach means no swimming, but it doesn't matter because the view and atmosphere are incredible. Been coming here with our boys since they were babies, and it never disappoints. The food and drinks don't leave a strong impression, but that's not what we come for.
Revise this with your best effort: This location is truly a perfect spot to capture the beauty of a sunset. Although it may require a bit of a drive from Tampa, the experience is undoubtedly worthwhile. The vibrant music and lively atmosphere contribute to its overall pleasantness. Although the beach may be rocky and unsuitable for swimming, it doesn't diminish the fact that the view and atmosphere are absolutely breathtaking. We have been visiting this place with our beloved boys since their infancy, and it has never failed to exceed our expectations. While the food and drinks may not leave a lasting impression, it is important to note that they are not the main reason for our visits.

input: This place has been thriving since 1958 for a reason. They offer great soft serve and scooped ice cream cones, as well as delightful boats, floats, and sundaes. The prices are also affordable. Highly recommend!
Revise this with your best effort: Since 1958, this exceptional establishment has been flourishing for a myriad of reasons. input: I stumbled upon this Mexican restaurant while in the area and craving some authentic cuisine. The pazole was delicious and had a great combination of flavors. The pazole, in particular, captivated my taste buds with its exquisite combination of flavors. A noteworthy highlight worth mentioning is their pineapple water, a must-try even for those who typically shy away from pineapples. I eagerly anticipate returning to experience the indulgence of their burritos. This hidden gem is truly a treasure!

input: El Arado is a decent place with reasonable prices, attentive staff, and good food. Despite a slight issue with the table, the waiter was quiet but attentive. In summary, El Arado provides an excellent choice for anyone seeking an affordable and satiating meal before embarking on a night out in the vibrant Fountain Square district, or even for those planning to enjoy the lively strip clubs in the vicinity.

input: I highly recommend the Loew's hotel - it's exceptionally clean, stylish, and offers amazing service. The breakfast is fantastic, with futuristic aesthetics that impress even the kids. The rooms are spacious, and the parking is convenient. 5 stars!

The raspberry truffle was my favorite, with its perfect balance of dark chocolate. The coffee was a delightful chaser, not too overpowering, and I didn't even need milk or sugar. The seating was nice, with enough room for our group of six. The service was great, with helpful staff suggesting flavors and labeling. I give it 4 out of 5 stars, as having one more staff member would benefit the overall service.
Revise this with your best effort: Our trip to NOLA concluded on a sweet note at Sweet Confections on Magazine St. Following a delightful lunch at Cochon, we fortuitously stumbled upon this charming gem. Among the truffles, the raspberry variety emerged as my personal favorite, boasting a flawless balance of rich dark chocolate. To complement our dessert, we savored a delightful coffee that proved to be a refreshing accompaniment without overpowering our palates. Remarkably, milk or sugar was not required to enhance its taste. The seating arrangements were pleasant and accommodating, providing ample space for our group of six to unwind and relish in the experience. The service we received was outstanding, with the amiable staff readily recommending flavors and diligently labeling the confections. While I am inclined to rate Sweet Confections with a commendable 4 out of 5 stars, I believe that the addition of one more staff member would greatly enhance the overall service.

input:
I heard about this place from a fellow Yelp Elite and decided to give it a try with my SO. We went on a Saturday morning and had to wait in line. 

The takoyaki appetizer was delicious - perfectly cooked and topped with sauces. The fried octopus was good but didn't come with enough mayo. 

Unfortunately, the ramen noodles were overcooked and didn't fit well with the dishes. The broth was flavorful, but the red chili one was too spicy and covered up the depth. I preferred the black garlic broth. 

Overall, the food was tasty and reasonably priced. The decor was nice, but there were screaming kids running around which made our meal unpleasant.
Revise this with your best effort:
Based on my experience, I decided to visit this establishment after a recommendation from a fellow Yelp Elite. Accompanied by my significant other, we made our way on a Saturday morning, only to be greeted by a line we had to patiently wait in.

To start off the meal, we indulged in the impeccably cooked takoyaki appetizer, generously drizzled with an assortment of delectable sauces. While the fried octopus dish was enjoyable, it would have been even better with a tad more mayo.

Regrettably, the ramen noodles did not live up to our expectations, as they were sadly overcooked and failed to harmonize with the other flavors on our plates. Nonetheless, the broth itself was rich and full-bodied, although the fiery red chili variant overshadowed its subtle nuances. Personally, I found the black garlic broth to be my preferred choice.

All in all, the food was flavorsome and reasonably priced, satisfying our palates to a considerable extent. Despite the tastefully designed decor, the presence of raucous children running amok marred the overall dining experience, leaving us somewhat bothered throughout our meal.

Review: Visited during Mardi Gras with friends. Despite the bustling atmosphere, most places were not overly crowded. However, the bartenders were disappointingly terrible - poor service and unappetizing pizza.

Not only was the food exceptional, but the prices were also quite reasonable. As luck would have it, we stumbled upon a special offer of a free appetizer when ordering two entrees. It was an unbeatable deal that made our dining experience even more enjoyable.

input: My girlfriends and I dined at the Creole House for dinner due to its proximity to our hotel. The bacon garlic oysters were average, as the flavors were overpowered by the cheese and bacon. The jumbo buffalo wings were tasty and well-seasoned. The jumbalaya pasta lacked flavor and was our least favorite, while the blackened red fish was just okay. The sautéed veggies accompanying the dish were excessively salty. The canal street red fish wasn't great and lacked garlic sauce. The paddle boat drinks tasted good but were more juice than alcohol. Overall, the food was underwhelming, earning the restaurant a solid 3 stars. On a positive note, our server, Alexander, provided excellent hospitality and tried his best to ensure our satisfaction.
Revise this with your best effort:
My girlfriends and I opted to have dinner at the Creole House due to its convenient location near our hotel. Although we were excited to try the bacon garlic oysters, we found them to be merely average. The flavors of the cheese and bacon overpowered the dish, leaving us wanting more of the natural oyster taste. However, we were pleasantly surprised by the jumbo buffalo wings, which were delicious and perfectly seasoned.

Sadly, the jambalaya pasta fell short in terms of flavor and quickly became our least favorite dish of the evening. The blackened red fish was also a bit underwhelming, failing to impress us. Additionally, the sautéed veggies served alongside the fish were excessively salty, greatly diminishing our enjoyment of the dish. The canal street red fish wasn't particularly great either, as it lacked the promised garlic sauce.

On the bright side, the paddle boat drinks were enjoyable, although we felt that they leaned more towards being fruity juices rather than alcoholic beverages. All in all, the food at the Creole House left us feeling underwhelmed, leading us to award the restaurant a solid 3-star rating.

On a positive note, we received exceptional service from our server, Alexander. He went above and beyond to ensure our satisfaction, providing us with excellent hospitality throughout our dining experience.

While I save my 5-star rating for places that serve locally caught fresh fish, Tokyo is a must-visit for sushi lovers. The menu may be simple, but it is executed flawlessly, offering reasonably priced rolls that are an explosion of flavors from the abundance of fish. Surprisingly, the use of flash-frozen sashimi grade fish does not compromise the taste. The hues, textures, flavors, and even the aroma are all perfectly preserved.

One cannot help but be amazed by the breathtaking spicy tuna roll. It is truly extraordinary, thanks to the harmonious combination of kewpie mayo, sriracha, and sichimi powder. This delightful establishment has me hooked, and I find myself indulging in their delectable creations for lunch consistently. The addition of short-grain brown sushi rice elevates the entire sushi experience to new heights.

Observing the skilled YC Park, also known as The Sushiman, is a captivating sight. His effortless precision as he effortlessly peels a cucumber with a sushi knife, seamlessly transforming it into a nori sheet for his rolls, is truly mesmerizing. The temaki rolls are generously filled with an array of fish, and the nigiri is presented with utmost beauty and elegance.

While I reserve my highest rating for places that serve locally caught, fresh fish, Tokyo is an absolute must-visit for sushi enthusiasts. In these challenging times, it is important to support the dedicated owners of this establishment, rather than opting for Kooma or saving Mikimotos for a special occasion. If you have an insatiable craving for sushi, look no further than the extraordinary Tokyo!
